title: Duality ruins what ego keeps defending
summary: Ego keeps its unrest alive by loving two masters. Stop asking ego for the peace only truth can hold.
takeaway: Stop asking ego for the peace only truth can hold.
lifeApplication: When you want peace, name the second loyalty you are protecting and bring it back under the True One.
